system.description:
“I am the aegis. I am the spear.” As a celestial champion, you take to the sky on wings of light, protecting the worthy with divine intervention and smiting your foes with a radiant javelin.

LEVEL 3

Javelin of Light.

Free Action. Create a javelin of light that deals Piercing or Radiant damage. It disappears at the end of your turn. These javelins' die increase 1 step at levels 7, 11 and 15.

Paragon's Wings.

When you use Coordinated Strike, both you and your chosen ally gain a flying speed equal to your walk speed, 1 turn. You both can move for free once before attacking or casting a spell.

LEVEL 7

Winged Shield.

You can Interpose up to 8 spaces away. When you Interpose, you gain LVL temp HP for that attack.

LEVEL 11

Defender's Zeal.

Whenever you or ally you can see gains a Wound, you gain 1 Coordinated Strike charge.

LEVEL 15

Ascended Wings.

You gain Paragon's Wings flying speed permanently. Allies deal +INT Radiant damage on attacks and spells while they have a flying speed granted by you.

Combat Abilities

Commander's Order

Brace for Impact! (1/encounter) Reaction: When you or your allies that can hear you are forced to make a save. Allies that can hear you gain advantage on their save.

Go for the Eyes! (1/encounter) Free Action. A target of your choice in Range 6 is inspired. Their attack inflicts Blinded on hit for 1 minute or until they make a STR save on their turn.

It's Just a Flesh Wound! (INT/Safe Rest) Reaction: When an ally in Range 6 gains a Wound. Target ally regains INT+5 HP.

Combat Tactics

Sundering Strike. Your attack deals extra damage equal to a roll of your Combat Die and inflicts Sundered.

Blazing Strike. Your attack deals extra Fire damage equal to a roll of your Combat Die and the target gains Smoldering.

Maiming Strike. Your attack deals extra damage equal to a roll of your Combat Die and the target is Maimed: Slowed and Dazed. Maimed cannot be removed until the target makes a STR save on its turn.

Weapon Mastery

Javelin. Your javelin attacks treat monster armor as 1 tier lower.
